obligation: USCG Cybersecurity in the Marine Transportation System final rule
basis: 101.605(a) reaches owners and operators of vessels, facilities and OCS facilities required to have a security plan under 33 CFR parts 104 to 106. All operations are onshore in Florida; the company has no vessel, waterfront facility or OCS facility and no such security plan

Applies to pipeline and LNG owners and operators that TSA has notified. The company operates no pipeline: crude is sold at the lease and hauled by the purchaser's trucks, gas is sold at the lease meter into a third party's gathering system, and TSA has not notified the company

No final rule. As proposed, 226.2 reaches entities that exceed the SBA size standard or meet a sector criterion; the company has 250 employees against 1,250 for NAICS 211120 and meets no sector criterion

obligation: PHMSA hazardous liquid pipeline safety, including control room management
basis: Part 195 excludes onshore production facilities and flow lines and transportation by tank truck; the company's piping is production facility piping

obligation: Florida Information Protection Act (data security, breach notice, third-party agents)
basis: The company maintains personal information of Florida residents: royalty owner names with Social Security numbers and bank accounts, employee Social Security, driver license and health plan numbers, and vehicle geolocation. Subsection (8) covers customer records, and the company has no consumer customers

obligation: Oil discharge notice (Clean Water Act section 311(b)(3))
basis: The company stores and moves crude and produced water at tank batteries, an injection plant and flow lines; a release caused by loss of SCADA control could reach water

obligation: FTC Act section 5 (unfair or deceptive practices)
basis: Applies to security and AI claims the company makes, for example in lender and partner questionnaire answers
The policy requires MFA on remote access to company systems

obligation: NIST CSF 2.0 with NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3
basis: No binding federal sector cyber rule applies (rows above). The lender's and partners' questionnaires are organized around CSF themes

obligation: Florida oil and gas program (permits, production reports)
citation: State oil and gas program rules
basis: Operational requirements, not cybersecurity rules; injection pressure limits are permit conditions and appear as a driver in P01

obligation: BSEE offshore oil and gas rules

basis: An oil and gas producer, not a mine; MSHA has no cybersecurity rules
The company holds no TSA or Coast Guard security plans or assessments
The company buys commercial well equipment and holds no controlled technology

obligation: FAR safeguarding and covered telecommunications clauses
basis: No federal contracts on the contract list
Revenue comes from crude and gas sales to two purchasers; no card payments are accepted
Privately held LLC with no registered securities
